result.title: Infinite Worlds from One Example: What Local Generators Must Share
result.comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables; further results in a supplementary file (47 pages, ancillary)
result.summary: Seeded noise lets games generate any region of an unbounded world on demand. We ask what such a generator needs when every small window must come from one example, the constraint behind Wave Function Collapse. The difficulty is that local constraints can require agreement over arbitrary distances: in a brick wall, each row keeps its place between the mortar lines. We study local generators, each cell a fixed function of the randomness near it. When the constraints carry a quantity that varies across the example, no generator that applies one rule, ignoring position, to independent randomness at every cell can be both exactly valid and faithful to the example's statistics, however far each cell reads. At radius r, staying faithful forces forbidden windows at a density of at least order 1/r, and a construction attains this order. To vary the quantity between exactly valid worlds, a generator needs randomness shared along its direction. We give a finitely checkable condition under which row types drawn from the seed and the position modulo a fixed period suffice for exact validity without learning. A search over the example's patches certifies these quantities and names the input each needs. Across 52 public examples of Wave Function Collapse and 27 from other implementations, it certifies only examples where a learned generator on independent randomness stays far from valid after repair. Given that input, a neural cellular automaton and a diffusion model become valid on 10 and 8 of the 12 certified examples that receive one, and on none from independent randomness. Valid means at most one forbidden window in a thousand after repair. With octaves of seeded noise elsewhere, the automaton is valid on 45 of the 52 public examples and 21 of the 27 from other implementations, and repair keeps random access.

AI.brief_summary: 研究无限程序化世界生成中「每个小窗口都必须取自单一示例」时局部生成器的能力边界：证明位置无关的局部规则无法同时精确有效且忠实于示例统计（半径 r 下违规窗口密度至少为 1/r 阶），指出需沿某方向共享随机性，并给出可有限检验的充分条件与在 WFC 样例上的验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「局部、位置无关的独立随机生成无法兼顾有效性与统计忠实」的不可行性结论，可能与并行/局部解码推理状态时缺乏全局 latent 一致性约束的问题形成类比，长程一致性与共享随机性线索可供核查；但研究对象是游戏内容生成，与 VLM 推理机制距离较远。
